name: True Friends
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendship is marked by steadfast love, faithful counsel, and honest communication. A genuine friend loves at all times and stands by in adversity, offering open rebuke rather than hidden affection, which fosters growth and safety within relationships. True friends require mutual friendliness and faithfulness, contrasting with those who sow strife and cause division. Ultimately, the Bible points to a friend who is even closer than a brother, emphasizing the deep, loyal bond that reflects Christ-centered love.
